editor_note: None of the three rewritten entries (3, 9, 10) would mislead a learner. Their meaning is faithful, including the stable-versus-drifting parameter distinction and the TLS, ambient-temperature and control-system causes. Entry 9 renders "quantum limited amplifiers" as "quantenbegrenzte Verstärker", but the usual German term is "quantenlimitierte Verstärker". It also adds a gloss that is not in the source, "Leakage (Leckage aus dem Rechenraum)"; the gloss is accurate but redundant. Entry 3 has English-shaped phrasing: "konsistente Leistung" (German writers would say "gleichbleibende Leistung") and "bestmögliche Leistung basierend auf Benchmarks".

examples.source: This includes the operational parameters of our quantum limited amplifiers.
examples.translation: Dies umfasst die Betriebsparameter unserer quantenbegrenzten Verstärker.
examples.suggested: Dazu gehören auch die Betriebsparameter unserer quantenlimitierten Verstärker.
examples.why: The usual German term for a quantum-limited amplifier is 'quantenlimitierter Verstärker'. 'quantenbegrenzt' can still be understood but is not the standard term.

examples.source: ensuring accurate state discrimination, low leakage and stable operation
examples.translation: um genaue Zustandsdiskriminierung, geringe Leakage (Leckage aus dem Rechenraum) und stabilen Betrieb sicherzustellen
examples.suggested: um eine genaue Zustandsunterscheidung, geringe Leakage und einen stabilen Betrieb sicherzustellen
examples.why: The parenthetical gloss is not in the source. It is correct, but it makes the list item clunky and puts an English term next to a German calque of it.

examples.source: the primary goal is to maintain consistent performance for the lifetime of the device
examples.translation: besteht das primäre Ziel darin, eine konsistente Leistung über die gesamte Lebensdauer des Geräts aufrechtzuerhalten
examples.suggested: ist das vorrangige Ziel, über die gesamte Lebensdauer des Geräts eine gleichbleibende Leistung sicherzustellen
examples.why: 'konsistente Leistung' and 'primäres Ziel' are calques of the English. A German technical writer would write 'gleichbleibende Leistung' and 'vorrangiges Ziel'.

editor_note: The meaning is accurate throughout. The role requirements in [5] (Administrator for rules, Editor/Administrator for network zones, Viewer can only add zones) and the caveat about compromised credentials in [4] are both kept intact. Two small editorial issues remain. In [4], "funktionieren mit traditionellen IAM-Richtlinien" is a calque of "work with"; "arbeiten mit ... zusammen" or "ergänzen" reads more natively. The name of the Context-based restrictions service is also written two ways: "Service Kontextbasierte Einschränkungen" in [5] and "Service für kontextbasierte Einschränkungen" in [6].

examples.source: These restrictions work with traditional IAM policies, which are based on identity, to provide an extra layer of protection.
examples.translation: Diese Einschränkungen funktionieren mit traditionellen IAM-Richtlinien, die auf Identität basieren, um eine zusätzliche Schutzebene bereitzustellen.
examples.suggested: Diese Einschränkungen ergänzen herkömmliche, identitätsbasierte IAM-Richtlinien um eine zusätzliche Schutzebene.
examples.why: 'funktionieren mit' is a literal calque of 'work with'. The sentence also has stiff English clause order.

examples.source: either the Editor or Administrator role on the Context-based restrictions service
examples.translation: Editor- oder Administrator-Rolle für den Service Kontextbasierte Einschränkungen
examples.suggested: Editor- oder Administrator-Rolle für den Service für kontextbasierte Einschränkungen
examples.why: The same service is called 'Service für kontextbasierte Einschränkungen' in [6]. The name should be written one way throughout the file.

editor_note: Rewritten entry [6] is faithful and would not mislead a learner. It keeps the right meaning throughout: PUBs as input to run(), the job executing the workload, and results whose format depends on both the PUBs and the runtime options ('sowohl von den verwendeten PUBs als auch von den vom Primitive angegebenen Laufzeitoptionen'). Register is correct du-form ('ermöglicht es dir … indem du … verwendest'). The only slip is orthographic. 'IBM Quantum® Rechenressourcen' is an open compound and German requires it to be hyphenated ('IBM-Quantum®-Rechenressourcen').

examples.source: which executes workloads on IBM Quantum® compute resources
examples.translation: das Workloads auf IBM Quantum® Rechenressourcen ausführt
examples.suggested: das Workloads auf IBM-Quantum®-Rechenressourcen ausführt
examples.why: German compounds made from a multi-word proper name plus a noun must be hyphenated throughout. Leaving the space open is a common error that an editor would fix. The meaning is unaffected.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries keep the meaning, and neither would mislead a learner. Entry 26 is clean: "probabilistische Fehlerauslöschung (Probabilistic Error Cancellation, PEC) zur Fehlerminderung". The one problem is in entry 27, which renders "two unique layers of CX gates" as "zwei eindeutigen Schichten". That is a calque, because "eindeutig" means "unambiguous" in German, while the source means two distinct layers. A native editor would write "zwei unterschiedliche Schichten" (or "verschiedene").

examples.source: two unique layers of CX gates
examples.translation: zwei eindeutigen Schichten von CX-Gates
examples.suggested: zwei unterschiedlichen Schichten aus CX-Gates
examples.why: In German, 'eindeutig' means 'unambiguous'. It is a calque of 'unique' in the sense of 'distinct', so it reads stiffly and is slightly off. 'unterschiedlich' or 'verschieden' says what the source means.

editor_note: Neither rewritten entry changes the meaning. Entry 8 keeps the acknowledgement and the full disclaimer, and entry 12 correctly calls ibmq_vigo one of the Canary processors. Entry 8 has two things a native editor would fix. "offizielle Politik" is a calque of "official policy" (better: "offizielle Haltung" or "Richtlinien"). The compounds "IBM Quantum Dienste" and "IBM Quantum Team" are open where German requires hyphens ("IBM-Quantum-Dienste", "IBM-Quantum-Team"); entry 12 has the same problem in "IBM Quantum Canary-Prozessoren". Entry 12 also uses "Artikel" for the paper, while the sentence just before it (entry 11) uses "Arbeit".

examples.source: do not reflect the official policy or position of IBM or the IBM Quantum team
examples.translation: spiegeln nicht die offizielle Politik oder Position von IBM oder dem IBM Quantum Team wider
examples.suggested: spiegeln nicht die offizielle Haltung oder Position von IBM oder des IBM-Quantum-Teams wider
examples.why: 'Politik' is a calque of 'policy'. German also needs hyphens in the multi-word compound, and the genitive reads better here.

examples.source: We acknowledge the use of IBM Quantum services for this work.
examples.translation: Wir danken für die Nutzung der IBM Quantum Dienste für diese Arbeit.
examples.suggested: Wir bedanken uns für die Nutzung der IBM-Quantum-Dienste im Rahmen dieser Arbeit.
examples.why: The open compound 'IBM Quantum Dienste' is non-standard German, and the repeated 'für ... für' reads stiffly.

examples.source: In this paper we used `ibmq_vigo`, which is one of the IBM Quantum Canary processors.
examples.translation: In diesem Artikel haben wir `ibmq_vigo` verwendet, einen der IBM Quantum Canary-Prozessoren.
examples.suggested: In dieser Arbeit haben wir `ibmq_vigo` verwendet, einen der IBM-Quantum-Canary-Prozessoren.
examples.why: The sentence just before it (entry 11) calls the paper 'Arbeit', and the compound needs full hyphenation.

editor_note: None of the five rewritten entries (8, 14, 33, 37, 42) would mislead a learner. Entries 14 and 37 are faithful, and 37 keeps the blue, gray and black line descriptions and the Gurobi comparison intact. The problems are in the other three. Entries 8 and 42 each add an explanatory gloss in parentheses, "neu zu gewichten (umzuschichten)" and "im Vergleich (benchmarken sie)", which a native editor would remove. Entry 33 says "das im Dictionary `…` gespeicherte Dictionary", a clumsy doubling that suggests one dictionary is nested inside another, where the English just says "the dictionary stored in `…`".

examples.source: Together, these metrics benchmark both computational and financial aspects of the quantum-generated portfolios.
examples.translation: Zusammen bewerten diese Metriken sowohl die rechnerischen als auch die finanziellen Aspekte der quantenerzeugten Portfolios im Vergleich (benchmarken sie).
examples.suggested: Zusammen dienen diese Metriken als Benchmark für die rechnerischen wie auch die finanziellen Aspekte der quantenerzeugten Portfolios.
examples.why: The parenthetical '(benchmarken sie)' is a translator's gloss left in the text. It reads as stiff and unfinished.

examples.source: read the dictionary stored in `dpo_result['metadata']['all_samples_metrics']`
examples.translation: Lies dazu das im Dictionary `dpo_result['metadata']['all_samples_metrics']` gespeicherte Dictionary
examples.suggested: Lies dazu das Dictionary unter `dpo_result['metadata']['all_samples_metrics']`
examples.why: 'Dictionary' appears twice and wrongly suggests the path itself names a dictionary that contains the target one. It is awkward and slightly confusing about the data structure.

examples.source: aims to rebalance periodic investments across a set of assets ... researchers in quantitative finance
examples.translation: immer wieder neu zu gewichten (umzuschichten) ... Forscher im Bereich der quantitativen Finanzen
examples.suggested: periodische Investitionen über mehrere Vermögenswerte hinweg umzuschichten ... Forschende im Bereich Quantitative Finance / Finanzmathematik
examples.why: The parenthetical synonym is a leftover gloss. 'der quantitativen Finanzen' is not the usual German name for the field.

editor_note: All five rewritten entries (6, 11, 27, 30, 37) keep the English meaning. The PUB contents, the metadata caveat ("keine Schlüssel-Wert-Paare, die durch das Basisprimitive garantiert werden") and the overlap/guarantee caveat for Execution Spans are all intact. There is one fluency slip. Entry 6 drops the definite article before the service name ("auf IBM Quantum® Compute Service ausführt"), and a native editor would write "auf dem IBM Quantum® Compute Service". Entry 30 already uses the article ("im IBM Quantum Compute Service").

examples.source: which executes workloads on the IBM Quantum® Compute Service
examples.translation: das Workloads auf IBM Quantum® Compute Service ausführt
examples.suggested: das Workloads auf dem IBM Quantum® Compute Service ausführt
examples.why: German needs the definite article before a named service used as a noun phrase. Without it the sentence reads as machine translation, and it doesn't match entry 30, which says "im IBM Quantum Compute Service".

editor_note: The three rewritten entries are faithful: [22] keeps the qubit order $q_n \otimes \cdots \otimes q_1$, [27] keeps "Phasen-Gate" and the Estimator caveat ("werden die Basistransformationen automatisch durchgeführt"), and [28] keeps the X/Y/Z basis for each of Qubit 0/1/2.

Both rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally. Entry 11 keeps the spin-context caveat as "es geht nicht um das äußerste rechte oder linke Qubit". Entry 27 keeps the right-to-left numbering intact: "Qiskit nummeriert Qubits beginnend bei 0, von rechts nach links".

All four rewritten entries keep the English meaning and read naturally. They use idiomatic German maths phrasing: "ohne Beschränkung der Allgemeinheit" (51), "echte Teilmenge" and "relativer Phasenunterschied" (25), and "die Umkehrung der gerade bewiesenen Aussage" (75). The "hingegen" in 25 correctly carries the "On the other hand" that was dropped from entry 23.

Nothing here would mislead a learner. Terms are right (Quantenfehlerkorrektur, 9-Qubit-Shor-Code, Diskretisierung von Fehlern), and the "du" register holds. A few spots read as translated. "Studieren" in [6] copies the English "study", and "sehr erhebliche Herausforderungen" in [3] is stiff. [3] also renders "possibly don't exist" as "möglicherweise auch nie existieren werden", which reads as a claim about the future rather than about whether such algorithms exist at all. "Large-scale" appears as both "groß angelegt" and "großmaßstäblich" in [3] and [5].

examples.source: We'll study quantum error correction in this course, with a focus on the fundamentals.
examples.translation: In diesem Kurs werden wir Quantenfehlerkorrektur mit Fokus auf die Grundlagen studieren.
examples.suggested: In diesem Kurs beschäftigen wir uns mit der Quantenfehlerkorrektur, mit Schwerpunkt auf den Grundlagen.
examples.why: 'studieren' copies the English 'study'. A German course text would say 'sich beschäftigen mit' or 'behandeln'.

examples.source: ...and possibly don't exist. There are, however, very significant challenges...
examples.translation: ...und möglicherweise auch nie existieren werden. Es gibt jedoch sehr erhebliche Herausforderungen...
examples.suggested: ...und möglicherweise gar nicht existieren. Es gibt jedoch erhebliche Herausforderungen...
examples.why: 'nie existieren werden' adds a future sense the English doesn't have. The English means such algorithms may simply not exist. 'sehr erhebliche' is also a stiff intensifier.

examples.source: large-scale quantum computer ... large-scale quantum computing
examples.translation: großmaßstäblichen Quantencomputers ... groß angelegte Quantencomputer
examples.suggested: Use 'groß angelegt' (or 'skalierbar') throughout, matching [3].
examples.why: 'Large-scale' has two renderings in the file, and 'großmaßstäblich' is unusual in German.

editor_note: All three rewritten entries match the English. Entry 15 renders the linearity caveat as "ergibt sich durch Linearität aus diesem Ausdruck", entry 23 keeps the one-query-versus-no-queries contrast ("erfordert $Z_f$ im Abfragemodell eine Abfrage, während $Z_{\mathrm{OR}}$ keine Abfragen benötigt"), and entry 32 keeps both options, running it again with a different $t$ or giving up with „keine Lösung“.

The meaning is faithful throughout. Phasenschätzungsproblem, Quanten-Fourier-Transformation, Shors Algorithmus and the DefinitionTooltip dates (1994/1997) all match the source, so nothing here would mislead a learner. Entry [5] has two small stylistic slips. First, "führt John Watrous durch den Inhalt" drops the object ("dich"), so the verb reads incomplete. Second, "[Folien herunterladen] für diese Lektion." leaves a trailing prepositional phrase after the imperative link text, which a German editor would reorder.

examples.source: John Watrous steps you through the content in this lesson
examples.translation: führt John Watrous durch den Inhalt dieser Lektion
examples.suggested: führt dich John Watrous durch den Inhalt dieser Lektion
examples.why: 'durch etwas führen' needs an accusative object. Leaving out 'dich' makes the verb sound incomplete, and the source also says 'you'.

examples.source: [Download the slides](...) for this lesson.
examples.translation: [Folien herunterladen](...) für diese Lektion.
examples.suggested: Die [Folien zu dieser Lektion](...) kannst du hier herunterladen.
examples.why: This is a calque of the English word order. In German, a phrase trailing after an infinitive-imperative link text reads as stiff and ungrammatical.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The pass threshold (16 of 20), the two-attempt lockout, the maintenance caveat and the Credly privacy notice all come through intact, and the text keeps the informal "du" throughout. A native editor would still fix a few small grammar slips. In [12], the genitive of "Badge" is missing its -s ("des Badge", "deines Badge"; should be "des Badges", "deines Badges"). In [0], a comma is missing before the main clause "und erhalte ein Badge". "IBM Training-Website" in [0] and [10] should be hyphenated as "IBM-Training-Website".

examples.source: with instructions for claiming the badge ... used to issue your badge
examples.translation: mit Anweisungen zum Einlösen des Badge ... zur Ausstellung deines Badge
examples.suggested: mit Anweisungen zum Einlösen des Badges ... zur Ausstellung deines Badges
examples.why: The genitive singular of the neuter noun "Badge" needs an -s. Leaving it off reads as a grammar slip.

examples.source: to test your quantum diagonalization algorithms skills and receive a badge through Credly
examples.translation: um deine Kenntnisse zu Quantendiagonalisierungsalgorithmen zu testen und erhalte ein Badge über Credly
examples.suggested: Lege eine Prüfung mit 20 Fragen auf der IBM-Training-Website ab, um deine Kenntnisse zu Quantendiagonalisierungsalgorithmen zu testen, und erhalte ein Badge über Credly.
examples.why: A comma is needed to close the infinitive clause before the imperative "und erhalte". Hyphenate "IBM-Training-Website". "Prüfung mit 20 Fragen" is smoother than "20-Fragen-Prüfung".

editor_note: None of the 8 rewritten entries changes the meaning. The (0,2π] rescaling recommendations in [14], [84] and [91] are kept, [91] correctly says "gemessen von der +x-Achse", and the "8 Merkmale auf nur 2 Qubits" claim in [128] is exact. Two phrasings are stiff. In [14], "keine von Menschen auf die Daten aufgezwungene Normalisierung" doubles the "auf" and reads like a calque. In [84], "Manche Literatur definiert die Kodierung möglicherweise so" is a literal rendering of "Some literature might define"; a German writer would put "In der Literatur wird … teils so definiert".

examples.line_approx: Im Quantencomputing und in der Quantenmechanik ist dies keine ...
examples.source: this is not a normalization imposed by people on the data, but a fundamental property of quantum states
examples.translation: ist dies keine von Menschen auf die Daten aufgezwungene Normalisierung
examples.suggested: ist dies keine Normalisierung, die den Daten von Menschen auferlegt wird, sondern eine fundamentale Eigenschaft von Quantenzuständen
examples.why: "auf die Daten aufgezwungen" doubles the "auf" and reads like a calque. "den Daten auferlegt" is the idiomatic phrase.

examples.source: Some literature might define the encoding such that the argument of the sine/cosine functions is ...
examples.translation: Manche Literatur definiert die Kodierung möglicherweise so, dass ...
examples.suggested: In der Literatur wird die Kodierung teils so definiert, dass ...
examples.why: "Manche Literatur definiert … möglicherweise" copies the English modal word for word. German technical prose would use the impersonal passive with "teils" or "mitunter".

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, and nothing here would mislead a learner. The error-management terms are handled consistently and correctly (Fehlerunterdrückung/-minderung/-erkennung/-korrektur, fehlertolerantes Quantencomputing, Rauschanpassung for noise tailoring). Three small things a native editor would still change. In [4], 'quantum separation' is calqued as 'Quantentrennung', which is not an established German term, and the bullets after 'sodass:' wrongly start with a capital 'Die'. In [11], 'that will help bring quantum advantage within reach' becomes 'die den Quantenvorteil in greifbare Nähe rücken', which drops the hedge 'help' and makes the claim slightly stronger.

examples.source: The computation demonstrates a quantum separation
examples.translation: Die Berechnung eine Quantentrennung zeigt
examples.suggested: die Berechnung eine Quantenseparation (einen nachweisbaren Quantenvorsprung) zeigt
examples.why: 'Quantentrennung' is a word-for-word calque and not a recognized German term. Also, the bullets continue the 'sodass' clause, so they should start in lowercase.

examples.source: the tools that will help bring quantum advantage within reach
examples.translation: die Werkzeuge ..., die den Quantenvorteil in greifbare Nähe rücken
examples.suggested: die Werkzeuge ..., die dazu beitragen, den Quantenvorteil in greifbare Nähe zu rücken
examples.why: Dropping 'help' slightly strengthens the claim. The original says the tools help, not that they bring advantage within reach on their own.

editor_note: Entry 14 "Tools für den Quantenvorteil" is a faithful, natural course title: "Quantenvorteil" is the standard German term for quantum advantage, and "Tools" is the usual word in German technical writing.

The rewritten entry 137 keeps the meaning of the English. Qubit k controls U^{2^k}, the eigenvalue of U^2 is e^{2*2πiθ}, and each qubit gets the phase kickback e^{2^k*2πiθ}, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The one problem is terminology consistency: 137 says "Phasen-Kickback", but entries 128 and 129 on the same page say "Phase-Kickback" and "Phase-Kickback-Mechanismus". A learner now sees the same concept spelled two ways. Either form works in German; pick one and use it on the whole page.

examples.line_approx: jedes dieser Qubits erfährt einen Phasen-Kickback
examples.source: each of these qubits will experience a phase kickback of $e^{2^k*2\pi i \theta}$
examples.translation: jedes dieser Qubits erfährt einen Phasen-Kickback von $e^{2^k*2\pi i \theta}$
examples.suggested: jedes dieser Qubits erfährt einen Phase-Kickback von $e^{2^k*2\pi i \theta}$ (matching entries 128/129), or switch 128/129 to "Phasen-Kickback"
examples.why: The same term is spelled "Phase-Kickback" in entries 128 and 129 but "Phasen-Kickback" here. That is a within-file inconsistency, not a change of meaning.

editor_note: None of the six rewritten entries (36, 90, 97, 116, 117, 118) would mislead a learner. Entry 90 keeps the claim that eavesdropping must happen *before* the bases are compared. Entry 97 keeps the caveat about noise versus a substantial fraction of mismatches. Entries 116 and 117 keep the deterministic-versus-probabilistic reasoning. Two small wording problems remain. In entry 36, "Oder, umgewandelt in Zahlen gemäß ihrer Position im Alphabet" copies the English comma, and "ihrer" has no clear antecedent. In entry 118, "nachdem wir das Abhören eingebaut haben" breaks from "Lauschangriff", which the rest of the page uses for eavesdropping, and "eingebaut" is informal.

examples.source: Or, converting to numbers by placement in the alphabet:
examples.translation: Oder, umgewandelt in Zahlen gemäß ihrer Position im Alphabet:
examples.suggested: Oder, in Zahlen umgewandelt nach der Position der Buchstaben im Alphabet:
examples.why: The comma after "Oder" and the order "umgewandelt in Zahlen" copy the English. "ihrer" has no clear antecedent, so the suggestion names "der Buchstaben".

examples.source: We will return to this after including eavesdropping.
examples.translation: Wir werden darauf zurückkommen, nachdem wir das Abhören eingebaut haben.
examples.suggested: Wir kommen darauf zurück, sobald wir einen Lauschangriff einbezogen haben.
examples.why: Everywhere else on the page, including the section headings, eavesdropping is "Lauschangriff". Here it becomes "Abhören", and "eingebaut" is informal.

editor_note: None of the 10 rewritten entries would mislead a learner. The little-endian note (21), the measurement-outcome table with "Keine" and "$X$ dann $Z$" (77), the swap-gate routing and its two conditions in 111 ("erst nach den Messungen … erst nach dem Anwenden der bedingten X- und Z-Gates"), and the noise lesson in 119 and 128 all match the English. Three things a native editor would still fix: entry 119 renders "quantum computing" as "Quantenberechnung", but entry 21 uses "Quantencomputing". Entry 116 ends on a clause with no object ("um auf einem Simulator auszuführen"). Entry 111 drops the "not even" emphasis ("not even related"), which softens the point that qubit 12 has no connection to Q's state before the measurements.

examples.source: This is an important lesson in quantum computing
examples.translation: Das ist eine wichtige Lektion in der Quantenberechnung
examples.suggested: Das ist eine wichtige Lektion für das Quantencomputing
examples.why: Entry 21 renders 'quantum computing' as 'Quantencomputing'. 'Quantenberechnung' means a single quantum computation, not the field.

examples.source: feel free to uncomment the simulator cells to run on a simulator
examples.translation: kannst du gerne die Kommentierung der Simulator-Zellen aufheben, um auf einem Simulator auszuführen
examples.suggested: kannst du die Simulator-Zellen einkommentieren, um den Code auf einem Simulator auszuführen
examples.why: 'ausführen' has no object here, so the clause reads as unfinished. 'Kommentierung aufheben' is also stiff.

examples.source: the state on qubit 12 is not even related to Q's secret state until measurements are made
examples.translation: dass der Zustand auf Qubit 12 erst nach den Messungen … mit Qs geheimem Zustand zusammenhängt
examples.suggested: dass der Zustand auf Qubit 12 vor den Messungen an den entfernten Qubits 0 und 1 noch nicht einmal mit Qs geheimem Zustand zusammenhängt
examples.why: The 'not even' emphasis is dropped. The meaning survives, but the teaching point loses some force.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries are faithful: [90] keeps the r-applications cycle back to |1⟩ ("nach $r$ Anwendungen wieder beim Zustand $|1\rangle$ landen"), and [103] keeps the circularity caveat ("Die Logik ist zirkulär … *ohne* den Eigenzustand zu initialisieren"). The noun form "dieses Unitären" is also used in [84], [96] and [124], so it is consistent across the page.

Rewritten entry 204 is faithful and natural: "negativen Wert", "Energie freigesetzt" and "niedrigere Energie ... als zwei einzelne Atome" keep the sign and the comparison direction of the English, and "6. Fazit" is a correct heading.
The three labels are faithful and use the standard German terms: Modules→Module, Computer Science→Informatik, Quantum Mechanics→Quantenmechanik.

None of the 15 rewritten entries changes the meaning. Reversibility, unitarity, right-to-left matrix action and the Map/Optimize/Execute/Post-process steps (Abbilden/Optimieren/Ausführen/Nachverarbeiten) all come through faithfully, and the quiz statement in [227] correctly keeps its false claim "im Allgemeinen irreversibel". Entry [231] uses "kollabieren" as a transitive verb ("die den Superpositionszustand … kollabieren"), which is ungrammatical in German and should be "kollabieren lassen". Entry [122] drops "we saw above", the back-reference to the earlier AND/OR discussion. Entries [190] and [195] open with the German „ but close with a straight " instead of the matching ".

examples.source: measurement operations that collapse the superposition state into one of the classically allowed states
examples.translation: Messoperationen enthalten, die den Superpositionszustand in einen der klassisch erlaubten Zustände kollabieren
examples.suggested: Messoperationen enthalten, die den Superpositionszustand in einen der klassisch erlaubten Zustände kollabieren lassen
examples.why: In German, 'kollabieren' is intransitive and cannot take a direct object. The sentence needs 'kollabieren lassen' (or 'überführen').

examples.translation: Das steht im Gegensatz zu den klassischen Gates wie AND oder OR
examples.suggested: Das steht im Gegensatz zu den oben betrachteten klassischen Gates wie AND oder OR
examples.why: The back-reference to the earlier classical-gate section is dropped. This is a small loss of connection for the learner.

examples.source: something called "error suppression and mitigation"
examples.translation: sogenannte „Fehlerunterdrückung und -mitigation"
examples.suggested: sogenannte „Fehlerunterdrückung und -mitigation“
examples.why: The quotation marks do not match: it opens with the German „ but closes with a straight ". The same problem appears in [195] around „Sampler".

editor_note: All four rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally: "transpilieren … auf die Basisgatter … abbilden" (77), "einkommentieren (die Kommentarzeichen entfernen)" for uncomment (79), the Bell's-theorem aside kept as "noch rätselhafter" (92), and the random initial states giving "ähnlich viele 0- und 1-Zustände" (98).

Entry 29 is faithful and natural: "Koeffizienten und Phasen der Observable-Terme werden ... ignoriert" keeps the ignore-then-re-apply caveat, with "Observable-Terme" and "Teilexperimente" matching entries 28 and 41.

All three rewritten entries are accurate. Entry 22 keeps the caveat that the automatic method "erlaubt ... keine Wiederverwendung von Qubit-Leitungen" and renders `Move`-Anweisungen and Wire Cuts the same way as the rest of the page.

None of the four rewritten entries (26, 27, 37, 41) would mislead a learner, and the du register holds ("Denk daran"). A native editor would still change three things. In [37], "evolved generator" became "zeitentwickelten Generator", which adds a time dimension the source doesn't have (the generator is propagated through the circuit), and it clashes with "entwickelten Anti-Rausch" in [40]. In [27], "unique layers" became "verschiedenen Schichten", but the heading [14] and outline [3] use "einzigartige Schichten". In [41], "parallel" sits so it attaches only to "angewendet", which narrows the English, where "in parallel" covers both the forward propagation and the application.

examples.source: we propagate the observable through that evolved generator
examples.translation: propagieren wir die Observable durch diesen zeitentwickelten Generator
examples.suggested: propagieren wir die Observable durch diesen propagierten (entwickelten) Generator
examples.why: The generator is evolved through the circuit, not in time. 'zeitentwickelt' adds that meaning and doesn't match 'entwickelten' in [40]. The same fix applies to 'zeitentwickelten Generatoren' at the end of the paragraph.

examples.source: we need to find the unique 2-qubit layers in our circuit
examples.translation: müssen wir die verschiedenen 2-Qubit-Schichten in unserem Circuit finden
examples.suggested: müssen wir die einzigartigen (eindeutigen) 2-Qubit-Schichten in unserem Circuit finden
examples.why: The heading [14] and outline [3] call these 'einzigartige Schichten'. Using a different word here hides that it is the same concept, which matches find_unique_box_instructions.

examples.source: the generators are forward-propagated and applied to the observable in parallel
examples.translation: dass die Generatoren vorwärtspropagiert und parallel auf die Observable angewendet werden
examples.suggested: dass die Generatoren parallel vorwärtspropagiert und auf die Observable angewendet werden
examples.why: In English, 'in parallel' covers both steps, which is why the core count matters. The German word order attaches it only to applying the generators to the observable.

editor_note: In entry 60, the English says only "tracking closely on most circuits". The German makes that more specific with "verläuft ... dicht an der SABRE-Kurve", naming SABRE as the reference. That is a plausible reading, since SABRE is the baseline, but it is not in the source, so the phrase should be neutral. Entry 43 adds a redundant gloss, "zerlegte (dekomponierte) Größe". Entry 54 uses "Circuit(s)" and the calque "Tabelle pro Circuit", while the surrounding prose (entries 52, 53, 56, 59) consistently uses "Schaltung(en)". The rest of entry 60 is faithful: "stabiler als SABRE und Rustiq" and the Rustiq variability caveat both match the English.

examples.source: tracking closely on most circuits without many outliers
examples.translation: verläuft bei den meisten Schaltungen dicht an der SABRE-Kurve, ohne viele Ausreißer
examples.suggested: verläuft bei den meisten Schaltungen dicht an den anderen Methoden, ohne viele Ausreißer
examples.why: Adds a specific reference (the SABRE curve) that the English does not state. This narrows the claim to one interpretation.

examples.source: The per-circuit table shows how each method compares on individual circuits.
examples.translation: Die Tabelle pro Circuit zeigt, wie die einzelnen Methoden bei den jeweiligen Circuits abschneiden.
examples.suggested: Die Tabelle mit den Einzelergebnissen zeigt, wie die Methoden bei den einzelnen Schaltungen abschneiden.
examples.why: The surrounding prose consistently uses 'Schaltung(en)', and 'Tabelle pro Circuit' is a calque.

examples.source: circuits whose decomposed size exceeds 1,500 gates
examples.translation: Schaltungen, deren zerlegte (dekomponierte) Größe 1.500 Gates übersteigt
examples.suggested: Schaltungen, deren Größe nach der Zerlegung 1.500 Gates übersteigt
examples.why: The parenthetical synonym is redundant and reads like a translator's note.

editor_note: All five rewritten entries are faithful and consistent with the rest of the page. Entry 29 keeps the right numbers (133/125/18, 156/144/21) and uses "Kopplungsmap" as the page does elsewhere, entry 35 correctly ends with "3-Schicht-Gate-Schedule" (the prompt showed it cut off, but the file has the full entry), entry 58 renders the GHZ magnetization argument accurately (±N, "nahe bei +N und −N konzentriert"), and entry 74 keeps the caveat about "normierte Varianz" and critical_angle = 0.5000.

Entry 12 is faithful and reads naturally ("jeder Vergleich der drei Strategien bei fester Größe in einem einzigen Job"). Most of entry 31 is also accurate: 15 sizes, 20 bitstrings, three strategies, three jobs in one Batch, and the memory-limit condition. The last sentence strays a little from the English. "lower execution usage" becomes "die QPU-Nutzungszeit senken", which is narrower than the source, and the added "vor allem" is not in the English. Neither change would mislead a learner, because reducing shots does lower QPU usage.

examples.source: Reduce `SHOTS` when the goal is to lower execution usage rather than the number or complexity of circuits.
examples.translation: Verringere `SHOTS`, wenn du vor allem die QPU-Nutzungszeit senken willst und nicht die Anzahl oder Komplexität der Circuits.
examples.suggested: Verringere `SHOTS`, wenn du die Ausführungsnutzung senken willst und nicht die Anzahl oder Komplexität der Circuits.
examples.why: 'vor allem' is added, and 'QPU-Nutzungszeit' is narrower than 'execution usage'. This does not mislead, but a closer rendering is better.

editor_note: None of the 11 rewritten entries would mislead a learner. The claims all carry over intact: the systematic offset and the drift caveats in [77], [78] and [88], the "about 70 seconds" of QPU time in [57], the note that the same error is assigned to both x and sx in [70], and "kurz vor der tatsächlichen Ausführung" in [92]. Two small wording slips remain. In [42], "ihren Fortschritt ausgibt, sobald er eintritt" is a stiff calque of "as it happens". In [94], "exposed" becomes "offengelegt", which means "disclosed" rather than "made available through the API".

examples.source: so that each stage prints its progress as it happens
examples.translation: damit jede Phase ihren Fortschritt ausgibt, sobald er eintritt
examples.suggested: damit jede Phase ihren Fortschritt laufend ausgibt
examples.why: A native writer would not say that progress 'tritt ein'. This literal calque of 'as it happens' reads stiffly.

examples.source: Learn how the reported calibration data is exposed in the [QPU information] guide
examples.translation: wie die gemeldeten Kalibrierungsdaten offengelegt werden
examples.suggested: wie die gemeldeten Kalibrierungsdaten bereitgestellt werden (bzw. abrufbar sind)
examples.why: Here 'exposed' is the API sense (made accessible). 'offengelegt' suggests the data is disclosed or revealed, which is slightly the wrong meaning.

editor_note: None of the 7 rewritten entries would mislead a learner. The meaning is faithful throughout: "factor of r" is correctly rendered as "Teiler von r", "proper factor" as "echter Teiler", and the leakage sentence in [63] is paraphrased cleanly. The remaining problems are style. In [22], "kontrollierten Unitären" / "der Unitären U" uses a bare adjective as a noun, which reads as a calque. Also in [22], the sentence-final period stays inside the display math before the dangling verb ("...\ket{\psi}.$$ erfüllt."). Integer factorization is rendered two ways among the rewritten entries: "ganzzahligen Faktorisierung" in [14]/[59] and "Faktorisierung ganzer Zahlen" in [66]. The first is the less idiomatic of the two.

examples.source: These controlled unitaries are exponentiated ... after the phase kickback operation via controlled-unitaries ... of the unitary $U$
examples.translation: Diese kontrollierten Unitären werden ... potenziert ... mittels kontrollierter Unitärer ... der Unitären $U$
examples.suggested: Diese kontrollierten unitären Operationen werden ... potenziert ... mittels der kontrollierten unitären Operationen ... des unitären Operators $U$
examples.why: Using the adjective 'Unitäre' as a noun copies English jargon. Native German technical prose says 'unitärer Operator' or 'unitäre Operation'.

examples.source: satisfying $$U \ket{\psi}= e^{2 \pi i \theta} \ket{\psi}.$$
examples.translation: die $$U \ket{\psi}= e^{2 \pi i \theta} \ket{\psi}.$$ erfüllt.
examples.suggested: die die Gleichung $$U \ket{\psi}= e^{2 \pi i \theta} \ket{\psi}$$ erfüllt.
examples.why: The period stays inside the display formula and the verb follows it, which gives two sentence ends. Better to rephrase so the verb does not trail after the display formula.

examples.source: connecting the order finding problem to integer factorization
examples.translation: mit der ganzzahligen Faktorisierung verknüpfen
examples.suggested: mit der Faktorisierung ganzer Zahlen verknüpfen
examples.why: The phrasing is inconsistent with [66], which uses 'Faktorisierung ganzer Zahlen'. 'Ganzzahlige Faktorisierung' is also the less idiomatic rendering.

editor_note: All 10 rewritten entries keep the meaning of the English, and none would mislead a learner. There are four small problems. Entry 6 leaves "approximate quantum compiling (AQC)" in English, while entries 11, 37, 38, 57 and 89 say "approximatives Quantenkompilieren". Entry 6 also uses the stiff "großmaßstäbliche", where the rest of the file says "großskalig". Entry 12 makes DSF feminine ("in eine DSF"), but everywhere else it is masculine ("den DSF", "der DSF"). Entry 57 opens the quote with „ but closes it with a straight ASCII ", so the quote marks don't match.

examples.line_approx: Das großmaßstäbliche Beispiel ... und approximate quantum compiling (AQC) kann
examples.source: The large-scale example requires substantial memory, and approximate quantum compiling (AQC) can take several hours
examples.translation: Das großmaßstäbliche Beispiel erfordert erheblichen Speicher, und approximate quantum compiling (AQC) kann auf typischen Laptop-Ressourcen mehrere Stunden dauern.
examples.suggested: Das großskalige Beispiel benötigt viel Arbeitsspeicher, und approximatives Quantenkompilieren (AQC) kann auf einem typischen Laptop mehrere Stunden dauern.
examples.why: The rest of the file translates AQC as 'approximatives Quantenkompilieren' and uses 'großskalig'. 'auf typischen Laptop-Ressourcen' is a calque of the English.

examples.source: Fourier-transform it into a DSF
examples.translation: mittels Fourier-Transformation in eine DSF umwandelst
examples.suggested: mittels Fourier-Transformation in einen DSF umwandelst
examples.why: DSF stands for 'der dynamische Strukturfaktor' and is masculine everywhere else in the file (entries 33, 35, 68). Here it is feminine.

examples.source: producing a shallower "AQC + Trotter" circuit
examples.translation: wodurch ein flacherer „AQC + Trotter"-Circuit entsteht.
examples.suggested: wodurch ein flacherer „AQC + Trotter“-Circuit entsteht.
examples.why: The German opening quote „ is closed with a straight ASCII " instead of “. Entry 38 closes it correctly.

examples.source: `get_dsf` applies mirror symmetry and clips negative values internally.
examples.translation: `get_dsf` wendet intern Spiegelsymmetrie an und begrenzt negative Werte.
examples.suggested: `get_dsf` wendet intern Spiegelsymmetrie an und schneidet negative Werte ab (setzt sie auf null).
examples.why: 'begrenzt' is vague. 'Clip' here means cutting negative values off at zero, and 'abschneiden' says that more exactly.

editor_note: Entry 7 is faithful: nothing is dropped, and the causal "da", the modal "kann ... unterstützen" and "zunehmend komplex" all match the English. The only problems are style. The stacked compound "hybriden Quanten-Klassik-Klassifizierungsworkflows" is hard to read, and it switches to "Klassifizierung" when the rest of the page uses "Klassifikation" (entries 0, 1, 23). "Werkzeugen zur Verwaltung dieser ... Systeme" and "variable erneuerbare Erzeugung" are close word-for-word renderings. German energy writing would usually say "Betrieb/Steuerung" and "volatile/fluktuierende erneuerbare Erzeugung".

examples.source: through a hybrid quantum–classical classification workflow
examples.translation: anhand eines hybriden Quanten-Klassik-Klassifizierungsworkflows
examples.suggested: anhand eines hybriden quantenklassischen Workflows zur Klassifikation
examples.why: This four-part compound is hard to read, and 'Klassifizierung' clashes with 'Klassifikation', which the page uses elsewhere (entries 0, 1, 23).

examples.source: tools for managing these increasingly complex systems ... variable renewable generation
examples.translation: Werkzeugen zur Verwaltung dieser zunehmend komplexen Systeme ... variable erneuerbare Erzeugung
examples.suggested: Werkzeugen für den Betrieb dieser zunehmend komplexen Systeme ... volatile erneuerbare Erzeugung
examples.why: 'Verwaltung' reads as administration, not running a power grid. German energy texts say 'volatile' or 'fluktuierende' for variable renewables. The meaning is kept, but the wording is a close copy of the English.

editor_note: None of the seven rewritten entries changes the meaning. Qualifiers and claims all carry over: "besser ... überein", "zuverlässigere Schätzungen", the bond-dimension caveat in [47], and "ein Knoten jedes Dreiecks mit dem vorherigen Dreieck" in [24]. The du register holds, and terms stay consistent with the rest of the page (Schaltkreis, Erwartungswert, Backend, Shots, Hamiltonoperator). A native editor would still fix three small things. In [7], "erweitertes Layout" means "extended layout", not "advanced layout". In [47], "mit einer beliebigen Wahl von 4096 Shots" is a calque. In [50], "IBM Quantum Estimator-Primitiv" is only partly hyphenated and should be written as one hyphenated compound.

examples.source: advanced layout, routing
examples.translation: erweitertes Layout, Routing
examples.suggested: fortgeschrittenes Layout, Routing
examples.why: 'erweitert' means extended, not advanced. The reader still recognizes the term, so this is minor.

examples.source: with an arbitrary choice of $4096$ shots
examples.translation: mit einer beliebigen Wahl von $4096$ Shots
examples.suggested: mit willkürlich gewählten $4096$ Shots
examples.why: Word-for-word calque of the English noun phrase. A German technical writer would use a participle instead.

examples.source: the standard IBM Quantum Estimator primitive
examples.translation: das standardmäßige IBM Quantum Estimator-Primitiv
examples.suggested: das Standard-Estimator-Primitiv von IBM Quantum
examples.why: This multi-word compound is hyphenated only at the end. German rules would hyphenate it throughout (IBM-Quantum-Estimator-Primitiv), and recasting it with 'von' reads more naturally.

editor_note: None of the 25 rewritten entries would mislead a learner. The meaning holds, including the probability-halving explanation for the qsphere in [51] and the job-queue advice in [108]. There are three small slips. Entry [89] lost its "iii)" marker, so the i)–iv) quiz numbering has a gap. "Circuit" is written as "Quantum Circuits" in [9] and [89] but as "Quanten-Circuits" in [97]. "Single-Qubit Gates" in [77] has no hyphen, while [76] uses "Multi-Qubit-Gates" and [111] uses "Ein-Qubit-Zustände".

examples.source: iii) You are given the quantum circuit described in the function below.
examples.translation: Dir ist der Quantum Circuit vorgegeben, der in der folgenden Funktion beschrieben ist.
examples.suggested: iii) Dir ist der Quantum Circuit vorgegeben, der in der folgenden Funktion beschrieben ist.
examples.why: The enumeration marker was dropped. The quiz headings go i), ii), iv) and skip iii).

examples.source: **Map** problem to quantum circuits and operators
examples.translation: **Abbilden** des Problems auf Quanten-Circuits und Operatoren
examples.suggested: **Abbilden** des Problems auf Quantum Circuits und Operatoren
examples.why: Inconsistent with 'Quantum Circuits' / 'Quantum Circuit' in entries 9 and 89.

examples.source: Now that you've understood the single-qubit gates
examples.translation: Jetzt, da du die Single-Qubit Gates verstanden hast
examples.suggested: Jetzt, da du die Single-Qubit-Gates verstanden hast
examples.why: German compounds need a hyphen here. The same sentence already writes 'Multi-Qubit Gates', and entry 76 writes 'Multi-Qubit-Gates', so the page is inconsistent.

editor_note: None of the three rewritten entries would mislead a learner. Entry 40 ("Quanteninformationsbits", "Quantum Circuits manuell entwerfen") and entry 94 carry the meaning faithfully and consistently use "du". Entry 5 needs two small fixes. The five-item list switches halfway from "indem wir dir 1) zeigen … 2) wie du …" to "und du 3) … erstellst", which is an awkward construction. It also writes "IBM Cloud-Konto", but the German compound needs hyphens throughout: "IBM-Cloud-Konto". In entry 94, "quantum circuit" is shortened to plain "Circuit", which is harmless.

examples.line_approx: indem wir dir 1) zeigen … und du 3) deinen ersten Quantum Circuit erstellst
examples.source: by 1) guiding you how to install qiskit 2) how to create IBM Cloud account … and 3) make your first quantum circuit
examples.translation: indem wir dir 1) zeigen, wie du Qiskit installierst, 2) wie du ein IBM Cloud-Konto erstellst … und du 3) deinen ersten Quantum Circuit erstellst
examples.suggested: Wir zeigen dir, 1) wie du Qiskit installierst, 2) wie du ein IBM-Cloud-Konto erstellst und `api_key` sowie `crn` vorbereitest, 3) wie du deinen ersten Quantum Circuit erstellst, 4) wie du ein Quantenzustand-Quiz löst und 5) wie du deine Circuits auf einem echten Quantencomputer ausführst und das Ergebnis darstellst.
examples.why: The list changes its construction partway through, so the sentence reads as stitched together. Using one parallel frame for all five items is clearer.

examples.source: IBM Cloud account
examples.translation: IBM Cloud-Konto
examples.suggested: IBM-Cloud-Konto
examples.why: German spelling hyphenates every part of a multi-word compound (Durchkopplung). Hyphenating only the last part is a common error.

editor_note: Rewritten entries 22 and 25 are faithful and natural in the du-form ("Ersetze in dem Code-Block, der auf die Referenzbilder folgt, … durch deinen API-Schlüssel / CRN-Code"), consistent with API-Schlüssel in [26] and CRN-Code in [24].

Both rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally: [48] keeps the "approach or exceed T2" condition ("an T2 heranreichen oder T2 sogar überschreiten") and names both hardware goals, and [72] keeps the two classical bits, the Bell-Paar preparation and the No-Cloning/Lichtgeschwindigkeit caveat.
